messages:
sophia: Heads-up — saw a perf regression on the short-context path after yesterday's kernel-autotune rollout. P50 for 8-16 tokens jumped ~22% on A100 canary.
ryan: ugh. repro on local? or only in canary?
sophia: only in canary so far. I pulled traces, looks like we flipped to a different fused attention kernel for sequences <32 that has worse small-batch throughput.
alejandra: which kernel variant? name?
sophia: `fast_fused_attn_v2` vs previous `fused_attn_small` we were using. autotune picked v2 for H100 numbers but on A100 it thrashes for tiny batches (single-request batches).
dan: any KV cache behavior noted? could it be cache warming + kernel handshake causing stalls?
sophia: yes — the KV cache miss/hit pattern shows frequent micro-evictions during prefill->decode transition where we switch path. You can see short-lived KV rebinds in the logs.
kai: can you paste the perf snippet?
sophia: ```
# tail perf.log
seq_len=12  avg_latency_ms=41.2  p50=38.7  p90=65.4  kernel=fast_fused_attn_v2
seq_len=12  avg_latency_ms=33.8  p50=31.5  p90=52.1  kernel=fused_attn_small
```
ryan: OK that makes it obvious. autotune knob favored v2 because of longctx benchmarks. Need an arch-aware constraint: prefer `fused_attn_small` on A100 for slen<=24.
alejandra: also we should smooth the bucket boundary — current switch at 16 is too sharp. propose a smoothing window (blend 12..28) with hysteresis and kernel handshake to avoid flipping mid-request.
dan: +1. Maybe implement a weighted decision: if recent 3 requests from this route were short, lock small kernel for N seconds. That prevents oscillation from mixed traffic.
sophia: I prototyped a simple handshake: prefill pins kernel choice for the decode of that request; if autoscaler suggests alternate kernel, defer until request complete. Stops KV rebinds.
kai: nice. any impact on throughput for large batches?
sophia: negligible — only affects path switch. We measured no regression for >64 tokens.
ryan: action items: 1) add arch-aware rule for A100/H100 (ryan) 2) implement smoothing window + hysteresis (alejandra) 3) add prefill->decode kernel handshake to avoid KV rebind (sophia) 4) run canary on A100 cluster (dan)
alejandra: will open a PR with config flags. thinking config names: `slen_blend_window`, `kernel_handoff_timeout_ms`, `arch_kernel_overrides`.
dan: i'll schedule a small canary tonight + add perf dashboards to capture p50/p90 for 8/12/16/24 tokens. ops-bot: canary deploy when ready?
ops-bot: noted: canary pipeline queued for cluster `a100-canary-1` once PR merges. :rocket:
ryan: also add a metric for KV-rebind-rate so we can correlate.
sophia: I'll add a short repro harness that simulates single-request arrival pattern to validate. Putting details in PR description.
kai: thumbs up. thanks all — let's keep the rollout gated until A100 canary shows no regression. :thumbsup:
